description: Step 1 of the SEO / GEO flow. Add 3–10 seed keywords that describe what the brand wants to rank for. After this, call seo_generate_keywords to expand them into the full keyword universe. Multilingual brands: pass `language` to explicitly scope these seed keywords to one of the brand's languages (en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs). Omit to use the brand's default SEO research language.

language.description: Explicitly scope these seed keywords to one of the brand's languages (en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs). Omit to use the brand's default SEO research language.

name: seo_add_seeds
